posts.title: In Memoriam: Peter G. Neumann
posts.description: One of the great applied computer scientists, Peter G. Neumann, died on May 17. There have already been obits published , including in the New York Times . I knew Peter since at least 1992, and I’m honored that he considered me one of his colleagues and friends, even staying overnight at my house once. posts.title: A New Book: "Don't Get Hacked!"
posts.description: I have a new book out, Don’t Get Hacked! Protecting Yourself at Home . It’s released under a Creative Commons license, so it’s freely sharable and redistributable. I’m working on making print copies available.

posts.title: Why Legislators Need Technologists
